5 · Ranked defects & suggested fixes (not applied)

HIGH #1 audit gate red: ground flatCoplanar 19 > baseline 17

audit-circuit miami exit 1; tests/data/scenery-audit-baseline.json:79. Sources (ground-audit --why): structures.js:133×315 (32 faces, ≤2.1 m²), miami.js:443×443 (10 faces: the palm loop `for i<18` places K(0.18+(i%6)*0.005) at dist 28+(i%3)*6, so i and i+6 land on the same site, i.e. duplicate palms), miami.js:588×591 (264 m²: arrival-court slab bottom and building bottoms are both at y=0.0, buried so invisible). Not visually harmful, but a ratchet over-run the deploy gate will flag.

Fix: Dedupe the palm loop (use i%6 and i%3→(i/6|0) independent, or 6 distinct dists); lift the court buildings 0.05 m or drop the slab bottom. Do NOT raise the baseline.

HIGH #2 Overcast and fog barely change the day sky

Frames *-orbit-day-overcast / -fog: sky stays saturated blue, no haze at the horizon; only ground tint/low haze changes. Wet, rain and storm respond correctly. Def sets pal.horizon [.80,.86,.90] and fogDensity 0.0014 (js/circuits/miami.js:38) but the horizon band is not visible in dry day either. Engine side: js/lighting/atmosphere.js (PR #1979 touched weather blend; not read in depth here).

Fix: Raise pal fogDensity for Miami or make weather blend desaturate zenith for overcast/fog; verify with lightState before/after. Engine owner call, UNCERTAIN which layer.

HIGH #3 Trees along the marina/T3 straight are conifers, comments say palms

miami.js:434-437 and :560-563 call forestEdge(... pineFrac:0). nature.js:1496-1511 emits only pine() or broadleaf tree(); it never emits palms, so the "palm tree line" renders as tiered cone trees (orbit 02/03, all weathers). Also furniture.tree:"none" (miami.js:58) falls through to kind "broad" in build-props.js:1731-1735.

Fix: Replace the two forestEdge calls with palmRow()/along(palm) (already defined at miami.js:887); add a 'none' branch in plantTree.

MED #4 Authored bankZones produce no banking

def.bankZones (miami.js:43-49, 3–3.5°) vs measured Tracks.bankAngle = 0 at all five fracs and centreline bank[] max 0.00°; def.banked=false. Cause not traced into engine (likely gated by banked); mark UNCERTAIN.

Fix: Either delete the zones or set the gate and re-verify a rendered lap (AGENTS: no sign flips without a rendered lap).

MED #5 Verge/terrain colour contradicts the brief

Brief §2: pal.runoff [.34,.33,.32] neutral grey; renders tan-brown with a puddled pattern in every dry frame (probably the baked ground texture tint over runoff). Ground beyond is a flat bright-green plain to the horizon (flatTerrain true, terrainOuter 90).

Fix: Check asset-pack tarmac/verge layer tint vs pal.runoff; consider a mid-distance tree/hedge belt so the 90 m plain edge does not read as a green table.

MED #6 Hard Rock Stadium reads as a featureless grey cylinder; at night a bright flat slab

S/F orbit/aerial frames: bowl = frustum (miami.js:302-305) + 48 box segments; the coral/teal rim only reads from afar (eye 0.66-0.685 shows magenta/teal crown). At night (orbit-night-dry 01) the near face is a bright pale slab with no visible neon rim although :275-279 and :307-310 add one — likely rim segments rejected (comment :250-252) or camera inside the bowl.

Fix: Check rejected segment count via a placement report; give the inner face tiering/texture or a darker night material.

MED #7 Building windows are unlit boxes at dusk/night

orbit-dusk-* and orbit-night-* frames 02-06: pastel/Deco/city boxes are dark with only neon bands lit, although cityFront/building are called with lit:true, windowCol (miami.js:426,449,760,775). Road lamp pools and floodlights do work. Cause unknown (city.js window emissive path); UNCERTAIN.

Fix: Inspect city.js lit-window path for night:false circuits; def has night:false so the 'lit' bit may be gated by def.night.

LOW #8 Undocumented 3.5 m hump at s 0.8605; no dip under bridges

def.elevations[0] {s .8605, halfM 220, rise 3.5} (miami.js:40); measured y 3.42 at 0.86 and T18 apex y 2.11. Brief §3 says flat except the Turnpike hump (+3.4 at 0.662, measured +3.18/3.52), and says the road DIPS under the bridges: measured min y −0.15, no dip.

Fix: Document or remove the 0.8605 hump; real circuit is essentially flat (Wikipedia gives no elevation).

LOW #9 Built length −0.85 % vs reality

Built 5366.5 m (1342 nodes); lengthKm 5.4; path.len 5421; real 5.412 km (Wikipedia). Turn count 19 matches. Straight lengths: 1232 m back straight (0.639–0.867), 444 m T11 run (0.459–0.541).

Fix: None required; tolerance fine.

LOW #10 Palm crowns are cubes; pit/stand roofs are plain slabs

Eye 0.635–0.685 frames: palm head = a large green cube over thin fronds; aerial 01 pit-building roof is a long unbroken grey slab.

Fix: palm() model upgrade (engine) / roof detail.

LOW #11 Unsupported / buried props (audit)

unsupported 8: hospitality-cube neon caps miami.js:320 (11 m gap); msc-yacht-club masts/helipad :539-547 flagged 17 m (stacked decks measured from the anchor, model intentionally sits on dry land — it is the 'fake marina' joke); buried 7: light-pool patches miami.js:832 (0.10 m deep: anchor is 0.3 below ground, patch at +0.06), campus court :588 (0.67). Within baselines.

Fix: Raise the :832 patch to +0.35.

6 · Gallery — view × time-of-day × weather × lap position

Filenames follow docs/tracks/GALLERY.md: miami-<nn>-<view>-<tod>-<weather>.png (tod before weather so build-gallery parses it). Orbit = default 1.5 m target orbit; aerial = dist 90, el 40.

orbit · day · dry

Baseline. Tan/brown verge (brief: neutral grey), flat saturated-blue sky, no horizon haze.

orbit · day · wet

Wet response OK: darker tarmac, soft reflections, grey-violet sky.

orbit · day · rain

Rain OK: streaks, strong mirror smears under buildings, desaturated sky.

orbit · day · overcast

Sky stays saturated blue — overcast barely changes the sky (wrong response).

orbit · day · fog

Fog is only low ground haze on one side; sky and horizon unchanged (weak response).

orbit · day · storm

Storm reads dark and green-grey, rain streaks, good response after PR #1979.

orbit · dusk · dry

Navy sky, warm key light and lamp pools; building windows still dark boxes.

orbit · dusk · rain

Dusk + rain.

orbit · night · dry

Lamp pools work; windows unlit; stadium slab bright flat grey at S/F.

orbit · night · rain

Neon bands and wet reflections read well; best night frames.

aerial · day · dry

Aerial (dist 90, el 40). Layout, plain grey stadium cylinder, flat green plain, props on dry ground.

eye · day · dry

Driver-eye height.
